meta.adset.cost-per-conv-outlier.headline: {subject} at ₹{costPerConv} per conversation

Launched alongside another {region} ad set targeting the same audience, causing auction self-competition. Pause or merge into the stronger ad set.

meta.adset.spend-no-conversions.body: Ad set has accumulated ₹{spend} in spend across {impressions} impressions without generating any lead conversations. Review creative and targeting or pause.

meta.adset.audience-overlap.body: {count} active ad sets are targeting {product} in {region} simultaneously. Consolidate budgets to reduce auction self-competition.

zoho.status.stuck-in-attempted.body: A majority of inbound leads have not been reached. Implement structured follow-up cadences and multi-channel outreach.

zoho.owner.concentration.body: {owner} holds {leadCount} of {totalAssigned} assigned leads. Redistribute inbound leads across the team to prevent follow-up bottlenecks.

zoho.meetings.zero.headline: Zero meetings scheduled across {totalLeads} inbound leads
zoho.meetings.zero.body: No discovery meetings have been booked despite active lead volume. Review sales outreach scripts and qualification criteria.

ga4.paid.no-attribution.headline: Paid campaign traffic missing GA4 attribution
ga4.paid.no-attribution.body: Meta Ads spent ₹{metaSpend} but GA4 reports {paidSocialSessions} Paid Social sessions. Verify UTM tagging parameters across all active ads.

ga4.country.suspected-bot.headline: Suspected bot traffic detected from {country}

gsc.zero-click-opportunity.headline: High-visibility opportunity: "{query}"
gsc.zero-click-opportunity.body: "{query}" earned {impressions} impressions at position #{position} with 0 clicks (gap to Page 1: +{gapToPage1}). Optimize on-page content to capture search traffic.

channel.status.degraded.headline: {subject} requires attention
channel.status.degraded.body: Channel status is {status}: {reason}. Review performance drivers and execute remediation plan.
